question: The 2028 Olympic Games will take place in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Los Angeles.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Los Angeles City was awarded the right to host the 2028 Olympic Games by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) in 2017.**
 
• Paris and Tokyo were also in the running for the 2024 Olympic Games, but Los Angeles withdrew its bid for 2024 and agreed to host the 2028 Games instead.
 
• Amsterdam has not been in contention for hosting the 2028 Olympic Games, as the Netherlands has not submitted a bid to the IOC for any upcoming Olympic Games.
 
• **It is worth noting that the 2020 Olympic Games, originally scheduled to take place in Tokyo, were postponed to 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Olympic Games are a major international multi-sport event, featuring thousands of athletes from around the world competing in various sports over a period of several weeks.
 
• **The event is held every four years, alternating between the Summer and Winter Games.**
 
• The current Olympic Games were founded by Baron Pierre de Coubertin.
 
• **Greece's Athens hosted the first modern Olympics in 1896.**
